title: Finch Circle Loyalty Program — Reinstated and Courtesy-Reissued Note Terms by Tier
content:
Two kinds of replacement Finch Notes exist in the Finch Circle Loyalty Program: a note reinstated after a return, and a courtesy reissue of a note that expired. Their per-tier terms are set out below.

| Tier | Minimum validity of a reinstated note (calendar days) | Courtesy reissues allowed in a rolling 12 months | Reissue window after expiry (calendar days) | Courtesy note validity (calendar days) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Finch Circle Member | 14 | 0 | 30 | 14 |
| Finch Circle Silver | 14 | 0 | 30 | 14 |
| Finch Circle Gold | 30 | 1 | 30 | 14 |
| Finch Circle Platinum | 30 | 1 | 30 | 14 |
| Finch Circle Diamond | 30 | 2 | 30 | 14 |
| Finch Circle Icon | 60 | 2 | 30 | 14 |

## What each column means

- **Minimum validity of a reinstated note** — the minimum calendar days of validity, counting the reinstatement date as day 1, given to a note reinstated after a return.
- **Courtesy reissues allowed** — the number of expired Finch Notes that can be reissued as a courtesy in a rolling 12 months.
- **Reissue window** — the calendar days after a note's expiry date within which a courtesy reissue can still be granted.
- **Courtesy note validity** — the calendar days of validity of a courtesy-reissued note, counting the reissue date as day 1. This is the standard courtesy note validity of each tier.

## Points read from the table (hypothetical)

- Finch Circle Member and Finch Circle Silver show 0 courtesy reissues in a rolling 12 months; Finch Circle Diamond and Finch Circle Icon show 2.
- A Finch Circle Icon reinstated note is given at least 60 days counting the reinstatement date as day 1: reinstated on 1 April, at least through 30 May.
- At every tier the reissue window is 30 calendar days and the standard courtesy note validity is 14 days.
